steps.cmd:
mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Online joint-space controller for VLABench select_chemistry_tube_common_sense.
Uses only rcb_client observations and proprioception; run incrementally in this episode.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()

def observe(cameras=("forward", "left", "right", "wrist"), depth=True):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="frames")

def qnow():
    return np.asarray(r.status().get("proprio", {}).get("now", []), dtype=float)

def move(target, seconds=1.0, cameras=None):
    """Smoothly move to one 9D joint_position target, keeping the fingers commanded."""
    p = qnow()
    if p.size == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("status did not include current proprioception")
    layout = r.spec()["proprio_layout"]
    cur = np.array([p[layout.index(f"joint{i}_pos")] for i in range(1, 8)] +
                   [p[layout.index("finger1_pos")], p[layout.index("finger2_pos")]], dtype=float)
    goal = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / r.spec()["control_dt"])))
    actions = cur[None, :] + np.linspace(1/n, 1, n)[:, None] * (goal-cur)[None, :]
    return r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=r.spec()["control_dt"], cameras=cameras, video="none")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(r.spec())
    print(r.status())
    result = observe()
    result.save("/app/output/observation")
    print(result.meta)
PY

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /app/output/gen.py
@@
 def qnow():
     return np.asarray(r.status().get("proprio", {}).get("now", []), dtype=float)
+
+def state():
+    """Return the latest named proprioception values."""
+    s = r.status()["proprio"]
+    return dict(zip(s["layout"], np.asarray(s["now"], dtype=float)))
+
+def arm_and_grip():
+    s = state()
+    return np.array([s[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)] +
+                    [s["finger1_pos"], s["finger2_pos"]], dtype=float)
+
+def tcp_position():
+    s = state()
+    return np.array([s["tcp_x"], s["tcp_y"], s["tcp_z"]], dtype=float)
@@
 def move(target, seconds=1.0, cameras=None):
@@
     return r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=r.spec()["control_dt"], cameras=cameras, video="none")
+
+def probe_jacobian(epsilon=0.01, dwell=0.4):
+    """Measure the current translational TCP Jacobian with tiny reversible joint probes."""
+    dt = r.spec()["control_dt"]
+    n = max(1, int(round(dwell / dt)))
+    start = arm_and_grip()
+    p0 = tcp_position()
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
+    for j in range(7):
+        test = start.copy()
+        test[j] += epsilon
+        rows = np.vstack([test, start])
+        res = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(rows, n, axis=0), dt=dt,
+                       interpolate="hold", video="none")
+        pp = np.asarray(res.proprio)
+        layout = r.spec()["proprio_layout"]
+        # Proprioception is sampled at 10 Hz; index n is the end of the first dwell.
+        k = min(n, len(pp)-1)
+        p1 = pp[k, [layout.index("tcp_x"), layout.index("tcp_y"), layout.index("tcp_z")]]
+        J[:, j] = (p1 - p0) / epsilon
+        start = arm_and_grip()
+        p0 = tcp_position()
+    return J
+
+def cartesian_step(delta, max_joint_step=0.20):
+    """Translate the TCP by a small increment using a measured local Jacobian."""
+    J = probe_jacobian()
+    dtheta = np.linalg.pinv(J, rcond=1e-3) @ np.asarray(delta, dtype=float)
+    scale = min(1.0, max_joint_step / max(1e-9, np.max(np.abs(dtheta))))
+    q = arm_and_grip()
+    q[:7] += scale * dtheta
+    return move(q, seconds=1.2)
*** End Patch";

+def tcp_pose():
+    s = state()
+    p = np.array([s["tcp_x"], s["tcp_y"], s["tcp_z"]], dtype=float)
+    q_wxyz = np.array([s[f"tcp_q{c}"] for c in ("w", "x", "y", "z")], dtype=float)
+    return p, Rotation.from_quat(q_wxyz[[1,2,3,0]])

@@

+
+def pose_jacobian(epsilon=0.01, dwell=0.4):
+    """Measure translational and angular TCP velocity per joint using reversible probes."""
+    dt = r.spec()["control_dt"]
+    n = max(1, int(round(dwell / dt)))
+    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
+    layout = r.spec()["proprio_layout"]
+    ip = [layout.index(k) for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")]
+    iq = [layout.index(f"tcp_q{c}") for c in ("w", "x", "y", "z")]
+    for j in range(7):
+        start = arm_and_grip()
+        before = state()
+        p0 = np.array([before[k] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")])
+        q0 = np.array([before[f"tcp_q{c}"] for c in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
+        R0 = Rotation.from_quat(q0[[1,2,3,0]])
+        test = start.copy()
+        test[j] += epsilon
+        res = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(np.vstack([test, start]), n, axis=0),
+                       dt=dt, interpolate="hold", video="none")
+        pp = np.asarray(res.proprio)
+        k = min(n, len(pp)-1)
+        p1 = pp[k, ip]
+        q1 = pp[k, iq]
+        R1 = Rotation.from_quat(q1[[1,2,3,0]])
+        J[:3, j] = (p1 - p0) / epsilon
+        J[3:, j] = (R1 * R0.inv()).as_rotvec() / epsilon
+    return J
+
+def pose_waypoint(target, q_des_wxyz, max_iters=8, max_xyz_step=0.025,
+                  max_rot_step=0.06, max_joint_step=0.10):
+    """Move the TCP to a position while holding a requested hand orientation."""
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    qd = np.asarray(q_des_wxyz, dtype=float)
+    Rd = Rotation.from_quat(qd[[1,2,3,0]])
+    limits = np.asarray(r.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["panda_joint_limits_rad"], dtype=float)
+    W = np.diag([1., 1., 1., .18, .18, .18])
+    for i in range(max_iters):
+        p, Rc = tcp_pose()
+        de = target - p
+        re = (Rd * Rc.inv()).as_rotvec()
+        nd, nr = np.linalg.norm(de), np.linalg.norm(re)
+        print(f"pose waypoint {i}: tcp={np.round(p,4)} pos_err={nd:.4f} rot_err={nr:.4f}")
+        if nd < .009 and nr < .035:
+            return
+        dp = de * min(1., max_xyz_step/max(1e-9, nd))
+        dr = re * min(1., max_rot_step/max(1e-9, nr))
+        J = pose_jacobian()
+        q = arm_and_grip()
+        lo = np.maximum(-max_joint_step, limits[:,0] - q[:7])
+        hi = np.minimum(max_joint_step, limits[:,1] - q[:7])
+        A = np.vstack([W @ J, .05 * np.eye(7)])
+        b = np.r_[W @ np.r_[dp, dr], np.zeros(7)]
+        dq = lsq_linear(A, b, bounds=(lo, hi), lsmr_tol="auto").x
+        q[:7] += dq
